comments.text: As a Learning, Design, and Measurement (LDM) Manager, give your reasons for applying to work with CARE International and for applying to this particular position. Bearing in mind the following job description and person specification, please indicate what experience, skills and interest you would bring to the job. Planning/ Design, Monitoring, Evaluation and Reporting, Information Management, Program and Data Quality assurance, Learning, sharing/networking, Staff management and mentoring
